description: Client-side Minecraft mod where mobs and players become real physics ragdolls that react to how they died. Minecraft 1.21 to 26.3, on Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge and Forge.

mods.name: Ragdoll Deaths
mods.description: Dead mobs become real physics ragdolls, thrown by the blow that killed them: they tumble down stairs, slump against walls, float in water and burn where lava touched them. Client-side and purely visual.

releases.notes:
- **Minecraft 1.21 to 1.21.11.** Every loader now also runs on 1.21 to 1.21.11, with the same physics bodies.
- **Death camera follows your body.** While you are dead, the view follows your own body's head and slowly circles it, keeping out of walls.
- **Player Body Until Respawn.** A new setting, on by default: a player's body stays until they respawn.

![The death camera following your body, which stays until you respawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1eTrUOwY/images/7223d04675607fa8f82eefbea9fdbf4110129b65.gif)

- **Shulkers are physics bodies.** The killing blow knocks the shell over and it tumbles as the full box it is; when its time is up it breaks like a shulker box of its color, with the box's breaking sound.
- Fixed: your own body was thrown about three times too far by the killing blow.
- Fixed: your own body could vanish a moment after you died.
- Fixed: the Quilt jars did not load on Quilt.
- Fixed: on Forge, a loading-error screen at startup, and the settings text missing.

releases.notes:
Dead mobs are now real physics bodies instead of playing a fixed animation.

- **Physics bodies.** A dying mob becomes rigid parts joined at its joints. It falls, tumbles, slides and comes to rest on whatever blocks are there: stairs, slabs, fences, walls. Armor and held items follow.
- **The killing blow matters.** Melee hits knock the body back; Knockback, sprint hits and Punch throw it further. Arrows hit the part they pass through. Creepers and TNT fling bodies away and walls block the blast. A mace smash drives the body down.
- **Dying muscles.** For about a second and a half the body braces and reaches, then goes limp.
- **Water and lava.** Bodies float and drift with the current; soul sand bubble columns lift them fast, magma ones slowly. Lava burns black exactly the pixels that touched it.
- **Materials.** Bodies slide far on ice, bounce on slime, hang in cobwebs and sink into powder snow.
- **Special mobs.** Skeletons break apart, a snow golem's pumpkin rolls off, blaze and breeze rods drop free, spiders flip and curl.
- **Sounds and dust.** Thuds, splashes and bone clatter, heard only by you.
- **Settings.** A new Physics section; turning Physics Bodies off brings back the 1.0 animations.
- Fixed: on 26.1.x a render hook did not apply, so limb and armor posing could fail.
